direction: Daily close channel breakout entries with a ratcheting Wilder-ATR trailing exit; independent unlevered BTC and ETH long-only accounts.
hypothesis: Volatility-scaled trailing exits may preserve persistent trends while limiting giveback after price reversals. This is a falsification grid, not a claim that ATR rules are profitable.

indicator_source.citation: TA-Lib official ATR source (Wilder smoothing and true-range definition).
indicator_source.implementation: TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prev_close),abs(L-prev_close)); ATR seed is the simple mean of the first n complete TR values; subsequent ATR=((n-1)*prior_ATR+TR)/n. Own transparent implementation is audited against these published steps.

rule.entry: At a newly closed UTC daily bar j, enter if close[j] is strictly greater than max(high[j-E:j]); the entry comparison excludes signal-day high and uses only the prior E complete daily highs. Signal is available at the close; execute at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open.
rule.initial_stop: At the entry signal day, initialize peak_close=close[j], entry_ATR=ATR_n[j], stop=peak_close-multiple*entry_ATR. The ATR value is frozen at entry.
rule.trailing_exit: On each later complete daily close, peak_close=max(prior_peak_close,close[j]); stop=max(prior_stop,peak_close-multiple*entry_ATR), so the stop only ratchets upward. If close[j] <= stop, signal a full exit for the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open. Stop is close-confirmed, not intraday or guaranteed executable at stop price.
rule.state: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset spot account, all initial capital in that sleeve, no leverage/short/add-ons/transfers/yield. After an exit, do not re-enter on that same decision day; a later daily signal can re-enter. A rejected historical order is not backfilled; evaluate the rule on the next newly closed daily bar.
rule.terminal: Any position still open at fixed OOS end is liquidated at the end-boundary next-minute-open reference with costs. No fill is created before OOS.

grid.entry_close_vs_prior_high: strictly greater; exclude current signal bar

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation folds. Account and indicator state remain continuous; no fitting or per-fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: This OOS window is reused throughout the repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.exchange_filters: Fresh public Binance exchangeInfo GET response, frozen in exchange_info_raw.json/exchange_filters.json; adverse PRICE tick rounding, LOT_SIZE floor, NOTIONAL and PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE checks via previous 5-minute VWAP proxy. Historical L2 and historical exchange filters are unavailable.

sensitivity.local_neighbor: Same asset; adjacent indices on all three frozen axes, with bounded neighbor cells; report 3× positive fraction.

failure_gates.interpretation: Historical reused-OOS screening only; no stable-live claim. DSR/PBO will not be asserted.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1-minute OHLCV. Aggregate complete UTC daily high, low, close, quote volume; retain source file hashes.

related_prior_results: Daily close channel rules use fixed-bar channel exits; no ATR/trailing stop found in complete strategy registry.
Daily EMA/ROC momentum and 4h momentum used different exit rules; this ATR trailing stop is a distinct configuration.
